address: House of Shinsegae,176 Sinbanpo-ro, Seocho-gu, Seoul, 06546, South Korea
bio: Yoon Haeundae Galbi, which began as a global brand for the Haeundae Rib Barbecue Restaurant, preserves the authenticity of Korean barbecue while introducing distinctive dishes that reflect contemporary Korean food trends. It features special grills that allow diners to enjoy noodles on the grills after their barbecue. Don't forget to order fresh galbi in advance, as it is available in limited quantities. The upscale and trendy dining space is suitable for a range of occasions; the counter-style barbecue area is perfect for a date.
